title: unsafe impl Send/Sync for RadosStore missing independent thread-safety proof
description: rados_store.rs lines 54-55: unsafe impl Send for RadosStore and unsafe impl Sync for RadosStore. The SAFETY comment argues IoCtx is Send+Sync and _rados is kept only to prevent Drop. However the comment does not cite a specific Ceph librados API guarantee that rados_t is safe to access from multiple threads simultaneously. The ceph crate's deliberate omission of Send/Sync is a signal that the upstream maintainer was uncertain. The comment must cite the exact librados documentation section that guarantees thread-safety of rados_t handle sharing, or the impl must be reconsidered.
